fix: Add a new package go/internal/modelcapacity with a CatalogReader and a UsageReader interface; it has no exec, no tmux and no CLI-name literal, and a repo-contract test pins this. Add the policy keys capacity.empty_below_pct and capacity.idle_above_pct. Add a read-only step in wave next that writes the three signals to the wave notes.
